text: The soul of San Francisco is not found in its iconic high-rises, in its commerce and trade, nor even in its unparalleled innovation and incomparable material wealth. The soul of our great City is found in the homes of all our neighbors: Gathering around the kitchen table, cuddling around the fireplace, tinkering in the garage, and laboring in the garden. The immutable soul of San Francisco lives in the myriad neighborhoods of our ever-changing City, and in homes like 80 Ulloa Street. For nearly nine decades, the men and women that have lived in this home have been among those that have defined our City's strength, and labored to create our City's wealth. A strength and wealth from which we all still benefit. The understated elegance and soul of homes like 80 Ulloa Street still attract those creators, and artists, and dreamers that, generation after generation, add to the fabric of our Golden City. The classic Forest Hill Extension home at 80 Ulloa is in the immediate vicinity of West Portal's neighborhood shops and restaurants, of public transportation, of public parks and playgrounds, and of freeways leading in all directions. While the home's next owners will surely want to add their own upgrades and improvements, every visitor will see that the home has been well loved and well maintained for decades. With good bones, Urban and Pacific Ocean views, and an abundance of light and air as a result of its unique setting directly adjacent to the idyllic tree-lined Sydney pathway, that joins Ulloa Street to Idora Street below it to the northwest, this fully detached home is truly a delight to behold.

address: 3175 San Bruno Ave, San Francisco, CA
text: Welcome to 3175 San Bruno Ave, located on the Sunny side of town! A 4-bedroom 2 bath move in ready single-family home that features a spacious and flexible layout. The entry level has 2 generous sized bedrooms and full bathroom. Upstairs, a spacious living room, formal dining room and eat in kitchen as well as 2 more bedrooms, including the primary and a full bath. The interior has been freshly painted, new LVP flooring, newer appliances, updates to the roof and plumbing. This home is a commuter's dream! Other amenities include close proximity to San Bruno Ave shops and restaurants, and McLaren Park- San Francisco's second largest park with approximately 314 acres of open space complete with hiking and bike trails, sports courts, a hummingbird farm and the Jerry Garcia Amphitheater. Additional features include a landscaped back yard with established fruit trees and flowers, 2 car side by side garage and laundry. This home has been in the same family since it was built, it has been well cared for and thoughtfully updated but is ready for its next chapter.

Welcome to 1 Hawkins Lane, a light-filled 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offering approximately 2,004 square feet of living space on a quiet cul-de-sac in San Francisco's La Salle Heights. The main living level features gleaming wood-tone floors, recessed lighting and two inviting living areas, one anchored by a wood-burning fireplace framed in polished black stone, with sliding glass doors opening to a sunny balcony. The updated kitchen showcases crisp white cabinetry, marble-look quartz counters, a deep stainless undermount sink with pull-down faucet and stainless appliances, including a gas range and dishwasher. A separate dining area with chandelier offers space for everyday meals and entertaining. Upstairs, the primary suite enjoys vaulted ceilings, corner windows framing tree-top views and a private en suite bath. Two additional bedrooms and stylish baths with marble-look tile and quartz vanities complete the home. Other highlights include in-unit laundry with front-load washer and dryer, an attached two-car garage, and a private fenced backyard with deck, low-maintenance turf, paver patio and garden beds. Close to Hilltop Park, India Basin Shoreline Park, Heron's Head Park and the Hunters Point Shipyard artist studios, with the Third Street T-line, Caltrain and Highways 101 and 280 nearby. Minutes to the Dogpatch's restaurants, breweries and galleries, plus Potrero Hill, Mission Bay, UCSF, Chase Center and Oracle Park. The 22.3 acre Candlestick Point development, San Francisco's new waterfront community has broken ground and will add major value to this area being the last affordable frontier in San Francisco. Opportunities are far and few and sometimes overlooked when presented. Do not let this opportunity slip by while it is still in your grasps!

Discover an exquisitely reimagined, fully detached residence in San Francisco's coveted Parkside neighborhood. Meticulously transformed with uncompromising attention to detail, this home offers 2,383 square feet of luxury where timeless elegance meets contemporary refinement. Featuring 4 bedrooms and 4.5 designer bathrooms, including 3 private en-suite retreats, the home showcases rich engineered wood floors, an abundance of natural light, and bespoke custom closets in every bedroom. The heart of the home is an open-concept chef's kitchen, appointed with a premium suite of Viking appliances and exquisite finishes, flowing seamlessly into expansive living and dining areas. It's ideal for everything from intimate evenings to grand celebrations. The lower level adds a welcoming family lounge with a stylish wet bar, perfect for entertaining, movie nights, or a private retreat. Enjoy nearby parks, the charming cafs, eateries, and boutiques of West Portal, the shopping and dining of Stonestown Galleria, and convenient public transit. 2144 17th Avenue is a rare opportunity in one of San Francisco's most desirable residential enclaves.

This stylishly updated home at 1205 Brussels St pairs a sleek, dormered white facade with a dramatic wrought-iron gated entry featuring a bold circular motif, offering both privacy and curb appeal alongside the attached garage. Inside, freshly finished flooring flows into an open living room with statement pendant lighting and on to a well-equipped kitchen. Remodeled with permits and designed by a professional designer, the kitchen showcases walnut-toned cabinetry, black countertops, a green glass tile backsplash, and stainless-steel appliances including a gas range with hood. The lower bedroom is generously proportioned, featuring a sliding glass door that opens to a spacious deck. An en-suite bath and a bright sitting area perfectly complement the space. Upstairs, you'll find second and third bedrooms offering bright, light-filled retreats with wood flooring, while a tiled powder room and an additional full bath add convenience. The bathrooms have been updated with new vanities and fresh essentials. Outside, a low-maintenance rear yard with mature trees and a wood deck provides a peaceful spot to unwind. A stellar example of 1959-quality construction and design, this home blends vintage character with modern style. Schedule a showing today to experience this home in person.

Welcome to 1483 47th Avenue, a beautifully remodeled Outer Sunset residence where exceptional craftsmanship, sophisticated design, and coastal living come together. Remodeled to the highest standards, this stunning home features raised ceilings and expansive skylights that flood the interior with natural light, creating a bright, open, and inviting atmosphere throughout. The upper level showcases two generously sized bedrooms and a beautifully appointed designer bathroom. At the heart of the home, the spacious living room, dining area, and kitchen blend seamlessly in a thoughtfully designed open-concept layout, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The chef's kitchen is a true centerpiece, featuring premium Thermador appliances, an oversized island, and a gorgeous quartz waterfall countertop, complemented by refined finishes and exceptional attention to detail. The lower level expands the home's versatility with an additional family room, a well-appointed bedroom, and a stylish designer bathroom. These inviting living spaces flow effortlessly to a beautifully landscaped rear yard, creating the perfect setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing in your own private retreat. Beyond its exceptional interiors, this home enjoys an enviable Outer Sunset location, just moments from the Pacific Ocean and the natural beauty of Ocean Beach, Sunset Dunes Park, and Golden Gate Park. Whether enjoying a coastal stroll, cycling along scenic paths, or exploring the city's expansive green spaces, outdoor recreation is always close at hand. The neighborhood's vibrant local scene offers an outstanding selection of beloved destinations, including Gus's Community Market for everyday essentials, Hook Fish Co. for fresh seafood, Outerlands for a memorable dining experience, Black Bird Bookstore for literary discoveries, and Mullusk and Aqua Surf Shop for surf-inspired style and coastal essentials. The surrounding neighborhood offers a welcoming community atmosphere, independent businesses, and the relaxed character that makes the Outer Sunset so desirable. Commuting is equally convenient, with the nearby N Judah providing direct access to downtown San Francisco and connections throughout the city. A rare opportunity to enjoy a high-end remodel, versatile living spaces, exceptional indoor-outdoor flow, and the best of San Francisco's coastal lifestyleall in one remarkable home.

Breathtaking, forever views of the ocean, rolling hills, Sutro Tower and Mt. Tamalpais take center stage in this bright and beautifully maintained two-level home. Designed to maximize its stunning natural surroundings with a skylight and, each floor of the home features a bedroom and bathroom for many possibilities. Enjoy an expansive, private outdoor deck framed by a lush, green-surround canopy. This exceptional outdoor space serves as a peaceful sanctuary for your morning coffee or a vibrant venue for hosting large gatherings. The thoughtful, multi-level layout features 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, offering an ideal balance of privacy and functionality. This home delivers the perfect blend of serene natural beauty and everyday convenience.

Some homes invite you to slow down. Reimagined with quiet confidence and an eye for craftsmanship, this Bernal Heights retreat feels warm and considered from the moment you enter. White oak millwork by Snakecraft, deep green accents, and natural textures carry a sense of continuity from room to room. Light moves through the open main level, where the kitchen, dining, and living spaces flow toward the patio. A custom oak banquette makes room for slow mornings and long dinners with friends. Handmade Fireclay tile, Miele appliances, and discreet storage bring beauty and purpose to the kitchen. A guest room and office shifts easily between work and welcome, its Murphy bed folding into an upholstered sofa. Three bedrooms on record, the home is currently configured as two, with the former third bedroom incorporated into the expanded living space. A full bath completes the level. Sonos audio sets the mood throughout every room and the outdoor spaces. The lower level offers a quieter rhythm. A serene primary suite with a soaking tub, generous shower, and outdoor access creates a retreat within the home, while a flexible bonus space with garage access and dedicated laundry bring ease to daily life. Outside, the home unfolds across three tiers of outdoor living. A sculptural outdoor kitchen and terraced succulent gardens lead to a sun-warmed upper deck, sheltered from the wind and open to sweeping Bay views. It's a place for reading, gathering, or simply watching the light change over the city. With Cortland Avenue's neighborhood favorites downhill and Bernal Heights Park uphill, this is a home that feels both connected to the city and wonderfully apart from it.

The adjoining dining area is warm and inviting, while the eat-in kitchen has solid wood cabinets, a skylight and stainless steel appliances. Situated on a 3,000 SqFt lot with a level rear yard, this home is conveniently located near the N-Judah, Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, and local eateries. A rare find!

Conveniently located near public transportation, shopping, dining, schools, and major commuter routes, this extraordinary property offers the perfect combination of modern luxury, comfort, and city convenience. A Rare Opportunity to Own a Spectacular Modern San Francisco Home. Must See!

Situated in the Outer Mission, this beautifully refreshed Marina-style home features a flexible two-level layout perfect for modern living, working, and active lifestyles. The light-filled upper level showcases hardwood floors, detailed crown molding, and a classic brick fireplace in the spacious living room. A seamless open flow leads into the formal dining room, which connects directly to a bright eat-in kitchen with wood cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and granite countertops. text: Welcome to 554 Mangels Avenue, a beautifully updated Mid-Century home in San Francisco's desirable Sunnyside neighborhood. Owner-occupy or invest in this rare mixed-use 3-unit, steps from vibrant Fillmore street shops and restaurants, with an estimated $213k in projected annual income. The building consists of a ground floor commercial unit with a stable tenant, Russian Hill Dog Grooming, and two residential units above, making this 3-story, 4200 SF building perfect for pure investment, 1031 exchange with rent upside, or an owner-occupant seeking a premier lower Pacific Heights location. Don't miss this opportunity to own a slice of classic San Francisco.

This 2-bedroom, 2-bath TIC was fully renovated with an open floor plan and thoughtfully redesigned layout that places the primary suite at the rear, buffered from the main living area by a guest room and full hallway bath. The home features tall ceilings and wide-plank white oak flooring, with sleek modern finishes from the bathroom vanities to the quartz waterfall island that anchors the kitchen. Both bedrooms feature large closets with fitted custom millwork; the primary includes an ensuite bathroom and bonus office space with access to the roof and ground floor via a shared back staircase. A large deeded ground-floor storage room with lighting and power suits storage, a workshop, or a small gym, with leased parking available nearby. ButterflyMX, Sonic Fiber, central heat and AC, in-unit laundry, and shared roof access round out the amenities. Building upgrades include seismic, systems, and roof. Set between Valencia and Mission, with Lazy Bear on the same block and Dandelion Chocolate and Tartine Bakery nearby, this is a turnkey home in one of San Francisco's most vibrant neighborhoods.

text: Commanding a corner position along a prestigious Pacific Heights, flat block sits 2401 Broadway. The residence's lengthy orientation displays an attractive example of fashionable, architectural tastes during the neighborhood's primary development years in the early 1900s. Coming to market for the first time in over fifty years, this sale offers an exciting opportunity to reimagine this special home for today's contemporary lifestyle. Within walking distance of the Union and Fillmore Street business districts and the city's well-regarded private schools, the property's location offers a rich community experience established over the past century. This is Pacific Heights living at its finest.

Built in 1875, 1705 Gough Street is a beautifully restored Italianate Victorian that brings together San Francisco architectural heritage and sophisticated contemporary living. Featured in The New York Times, the approximately 2,747-square-foot residence retains the craftsmanship and character of its era while offering refined modern finishes, three-car parking, a private landscaped garden, and two patios. Soaring ceilings, ornate columns, intricate crown molding, expansive windows, polished hardwood floors, and marble fireplaces create gracious interiors filled with natural light. Historic details are thoughtfully preserved throughout, balanced by a clean, contemporary aesthetic. The kitchen features marble countertops, a generous island, abundant storage, Viking appliances, and a welcoming breakfast area. Well-proportioned bedrooms and a dedicated home office provide flexibility and privacy. Spa-inspired baths include radiant-heated floors, marble showers, a soaking tub, and custom marble vanities. A major advantage is the rare three-car parking: a secure side-by-side two-car garage plus an additional dedicated space. For a historic Pacific Heights residence, this combination of convenience and security is particularly difficult to find. The private garden and two patios extend the living space outdoors, creating inviting settings for entertaining, al fresco dining, or quiet relaxation. Mature landscaping and layered greenery provide a peaceful sense of seclusion. The setting places Lafayette Park just steps away, with walking paths, open green spaces, dog-friendly areas, and sweeping Bay views. Fillmore Street is nearby, offering acclaimed restaurants, cafs, boutiques, galleries, and neighborhood conveniences. Union Street, Alta Plaza Park, and Cow Hollow are also within easy reach, making it possible to enjoy much of San Francisco on foot. 1705 Gough Street offers the qualities that endure: authentic architecture, gracious proportions, beautiful materials, private outdoor space, and unusually generous parking. 1705 Gough Street: a distinctive Pacific Heights residence that honors its historic character while embracing the elegance and ease of contemporary living.
